items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Yeah, I knew him quite well.

ctx.x: Nichols is some teacher. I think at a Pennsylvania college, like maybe Penn State or something like that. I don't know what he taught. I think he was. And I never did meet Ferguson, I'm sorry, because he must have been quite a nice guy and an important writer. A good writer. He was a good writer. An early jazz writer, yeah. He was a good writer. He died very early. I guess soon after this book came out, probably.
Do you know anything about Roger Pryor Dodge?
Yeah, I knew him quite well.
